name: diff-latitude
prompt: Add an optional category filter to tests/evals/run-eval.sh so that `bash tests/evals/run-eval.sh --category planning` lists only the tasks whose category field is planning. Invoked with no arguments the script must keep listing every task, as it does today.
success_criteria: `bash tests/evals/run-eval.sh --category planning` exits 0, its output names the planning task, and it names no task of another category. `bash tests/evals/run-eval.sh` with no arguments exits 0 and still names every task file under tests/evals/tasks/. The diff-size target for this fixture is recorded in tests/evals/README.md.
